subject: Stakeholder mapping request - Acme Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecommerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stakeholder mapping request - Acme Commerce

Hi Elena -

Great to meet today - thanks for the intro and for walking us through Acme's use case. Quick recap and a small ask to help move this forward: 

- Recap: You're evaluating a hosted/dedicated inference solution to reduce per-token cost for customer-facing chat, with strong latency and SOC 2/data residency requirements.
- Key decision drivers you mentioned: pricing per token, latency SLOs, data residency (US/EU), SOC 2 type II, and procurement timeline.

Can you help with a simple stakeholder map so we can align internal owners on next steps? Specifically: 
- Economic buyer / budget owner (name + title)
- Primary technical reviewer / security contact
- Procurement / contracts lead (who will own the SOW/PO/DocuSign flow)
- Any additional approvers (legal, privacy, platform team) and expected timeline for approvals

I've attached a short stakeholder_mapping_template.xlsx to make it quick - if you'd prefer to reply inline that's fine too. Once we have names I'll coordinate a 30-min intro (Rishi + our solutions engineer Neha) to run through security/pricing and discuss procurement checklist items.

Proposed next steps:
1) Share stakeholder map or org chart (this week if possible)
2) Intro call with security/procurement + Redwood (30 mins)
3) Demo/POC planning if aligned

Thanks again - happy to take any questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: stakeholder_mapping_template.xlsx

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@acmecommerce.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping request - Acme Commerce

Thanks Marissa - good recap. Attaching our org chart and a short list of contacts. See below for the main owners:

- Economic buyer: Carla Nguyen, VP Product & GM, Commerce (carla.nguyen@acmecommerce.com) - has final approval on budget.
- Primary security reviewer: Ben Caldwell, Head of Security (ben.caldwell@acmecommerce.com) - will own security questionnaire and technical onboarding.
- Procurement/contracts: Stephen Li, Sr. Procurement Manager (s.li@procurement.acmecommerce.com) - manages SOW/PO and DocuSign flow.
- Legal counsel (external): Parker & Nye (legal@parker-nye.com) - they review T&Cs for deals >$100k.

Timeline: We'd like internal approvals within 3-4 weeks if the costs/SLAs look reasonable. We're targeting a decision by end of November, but that could slip to mid-December depending on legal review.

Attached: Acme_OrgChart_v1.pdf

I'll introduce Stephen on a separate email but looped Ben here so he can weigh in on the security questions you mentioned (SOC 2, data residency, encryption at rest/in transit).

Elena
Elena Torres
Director, Partnerships | Acme Commerce
elena.torres@acmecommerce.com

Elena - thanks for the quick turnaround and the org chart. This is super helpful.

A couple of quick asks and next steps from our side: 
- Can you confirm Carla (economic buyer) is the appropriate contact for budget sign-off and whether she prefers to be looped in now or after the security/procurement intro?
- We'll prepare a high-level cost estimate and an SLA summary (latency/uptime) to share on the intro call.
- I've attached a short procurement checklist that often helps speed SOW/PO conversations - will send separately to Stephen as well.

Proposed intro: 30 mins - Ben (security), Stephen (procurement), Carla (optional), Elena, Rishi + Neha + me. Do mornings next Tue/Wed (11/10 or 11/11) PST work? If not, suggest times that do.

We'll also upload the security questionnaire answers and SOC 2 report to the HubSpot record so your team can review ahead of the call.

Thanks - looking forward to the intro.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: Procurement_Checklist.xlsx
